title: incident-bot: oncall automated diagnostics enrichment
author: Avery Chen
release_notes: Enhances incident-bot automated diagnostics: enriches runbook suggestions with SLO context, prioritizes on-call hints by recent run rates, and emits telemetry for diagnostic quality scoring. Backwards compatible; no user action required.
description: Motivation: on-call responders were missing key SLO/runbook context in automated diagnostics which slowed mean time to resolution. This PR enriches incident-bot's autodiagnostics payload and ranking to surface runbooks and hints that are SLO-aware and historically relevant. Changes: 1) include SLO and error-rate context in diagnostics payload so runbooks can be scored by impact; 2) add a lightweight runbook ranking model that uses recency, success rate, and SLO impact to surface top suggestions; 3) emit new telemetry events (diag.score, diag.hint_click) for QA and rollout metrics; 4) add end-to-end e2e tests and unit coverage for scoring edge cases; 5) migration: existing runbook entries gain a compat field (legacy_tags) to avoid breakage. This PR is focused on the runtime suggestion path and is backward compatible. See linked Linear tasks SRE-482 and ENG-2141 for design and benchmarks.

review_comments: Ravi Patel (reviewer): Can we avoid pulling full SLO definitions in the hot path? This could add latency.||Author (Avery Chen): Good call. Payload includes SLO id and compact metrics (error_rate_5m, p95_latency) only. Full SLO lookup is async (background) and only used for re-ranking when available.

Marta Lopez (reviewer): Add unit tests for edgecase where runbooks have no historical hits.||Author: Added unit test in ranker_test covering empty-history fallback to static priority and documented behavior in docs/runbooks.md.
